claim: Taihe upper and lower levels each have four corner riders and forty walking beasts, hence ten walking beasts per corner on each level; 80 walking beasts plus 8 separate riders.

source.title: 太和殿行什相关问题讨论
source.author: 黄希明
source.publication: 故宫博物院院刊 2014年第2期，总第172期，pp.141–146
source.cropConvention: left, top, right, bottom, with right/bottom excluded
source.observation: The inventory paragraph separately assigns four riders and forty walking beasts to the upper four corners and again to the lower four corners. The author explicitly interprets this as ten walking beasts.
source.archiveAttribution: Jiang Zao, Taihe Dian Jishi, volume 7, pottery work; original archival volume was not independently viewed.
source.dateCaveat: 2014 scholarly discussion of the Kangxi rebuilding record, not a 2026 corner-by-corner photographic survey. URL date 2018-06-04 is the upload date, not publication or photography date.

excludedClaims: current photographic count for every corner
modelFitCaveat: 63.6 by 37.6 roof inputs, relative spacing, and box body/head scale are retained model fits, not historical measurements. The rider cone positions remain exact legacy positions.
